Synthetic image decoding fixtures; no game resources are included.

color_blocks.jpg: 16x8 RGB JPEG, red left half and green right half.
gray_73.jpg: 8x8 grayscale JPEG, every sample equals 73.
cmyk_blocks.jpg: 16x8 CMYK JPEG, left (0,255,255,0), right (255,0,255,0).

The grayscale and CMYK fixtures were generated with Pillow, quality=100;
CMYK uses subsampling=0. Their colors are constant within 8x8 blocks so the
regressions exercise channel interpretation without relying on lossy edges.
PNG fixtures are encoded in memory by the tests for exact sample assertions.
